title_en: Spring 2027 On-Campus Scholarship Application (Deadline: Friday 11 December 2026, 18:00)
summary: Undergraduate and graduate students due to register for Spring 2027, international students, and students newly eligible for national merit or North Korean defector scholarships who wish to receive an on-campus scholarship must apply between 23 November 2026 and 18:00 on 11 December 2026. Most applicants apply through mySNU; incoming graduate students admitted for Spring 2027 must instead email the attached application form to the department scholarship officer. Students who do not apply within the period cannot receive or be recommended for on-campus or Development Foundation scholarships, and late applications are not accepted.
applies_to: Students who wish to receive an on-campus scholarship for Spring 2027: undergraduate and graduate students due to register (등록대상자) for Spring 2027, international students, and students who have newly become eligible for national merit (국가유공) or North Korean defector (북한이탈) scholarships. This includes incoming graduate students (admitted applicants) due to register for Spring 2027, who must apply by email rather than mySNU. Application is required for anyone who wishes to receive or be recommended for an on-campus, external or Development Foundation scholarship.

dates.what: Deadline to email income proof documents (PDF) to the department office, for (low-income) international student applicants

conditions: Students who do not apply for the on-campus scholarship cannot receive, or be recommended for, on-campus, external or Development Foundation scholarships.
Applications are not accepted after the application period.
The reason for applying must be written in detail; an insufficient reason is grounds for not being selected.
The academic advisor will review the reason for applying, so it must be complete.
No advisor signature and no paper documents are required; the department office will request each applicant's advisor's approval separately.
Entering a bank account number in your own name under Personal Information in mySNU is required.
Incoming graduate students admitted for Spring 2027 cannot apply through mySNU and must apply by emailing the attached form, which must include the advisor's name.
To avoid disadvantage in selection for scholarships based on the student financial aid income bracket (학자금지원구간), you must apply during the first National Scholarship application period.

If you need an income bracket for scholarships that use it (such as the Seonhan Injae Scholarship, the Graduate Student Living Support Scholarship and other external foundation scholarships), you must apply for the National Scholarship; this includes students not eligible for the National Scholarship, such as returning students and recipients of other scholarships.
An income bracket is valid only for the semester for which it was calculated; the previous semester's bracket cannot be used.

Undergraduates can obtain an income bracket through the Korea Student Aid Foundation National Scholarship, national work-study or student loan application; graduate students can obtain one by applying for a student loan.
For an undergraduate recommendation letter for insufficient grades, the previous semester's grade average must be at least 1.7.
A new scholarship for low-income graduate students is planned from Spring 2027, so graduate students must apply for an income bracket; calculation takes about 8 weeks, so apply early.

Students on recommended leave of absence (권고휴학자) may be selected once only, in the semester they return, through a recommendation letter from the chair of their college's scholarship working committee; their applications may be accepted outside the application period.
steps: All applicants: Read the attached application guides for undergraduates and graduate students (attachments 1 and 2); their contents were not read for this translation.
All applicants: In mySNU, enter a bank account number in your own name under Personal Information (개인정보).

Applicants using mySNU: Between 23 November 2026 and 18:00 on 11 December 2026, go to mySNU (http://my.snu.ac.kr) → 학사정보 (Academic Information) → 장학 (Scholarship) → 신청/현황 (Application/Status) → 장학신청 (Scholarship Application).
Applicants using mySNU: Select the relevant scholarship from the 신청가능 목록 (list of available scholarships), fill in the application form with a detailed reason for applying, and click '신청' (Apply).
Applicants using mySNU: Check that the status shows '신청완료' (Application Completed).

Incoming graduate students admitted for Spring 2027: Fill in the attached 장학선정신청서 (Scholarship Selection Application Form, attachment 3-1), including your academic advisor's name and a detailed reason for applying.

Incoming graduate students admitted for Spring 2027: Email the completed form to the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering scholarship officer by 18:00 on 11 December 2026 (the email address is in the original notice).
(Low-income) international student applicants: Email your income proof documents as a PDF to the department office by Wednesday 6 January 2027 (the email address is in the original notice).

Students who need an income bracket: Apply for the National Scholarship during its first application period (see the department's separate notice on the Spring 2027 first National Scholarship application); graduate students apply for a student loan to obtain a bracket, and should apply early because calculation takes about 8 weeks.
translation:
Spring 2027 On-Campus Scholarship Application (until Friday 11 December, 18:00)

We announce the Spring 2027 on-campus scholarship application as follows. Students who wish to receive a scholarship must read the details below carefully and apply within the period.
(Students who do not apply for the on-campus scholarship cannot receive, or be recommended for, on-campus or Development Foundation scholarships.)

1. Eligible applicants: Undergraduate and graduate students due to register for Spring 2027 who wish to receive an on-campus scholarship, international students, and students newly eligible for national merit (국가유공) or North Korean defector (북한이탈) scholarships.

2. Application period: Monday 23 November 2026 to Friday 11 December 2026, 18:00.

3. How to apply: mySNU (http://my.snu.ac.kr) → 학사정보 (Academic Information) → 장학 (Scholarship) → 신청/현황 (Application/Status) → 장학신청 (Scholarship Application) → select the relevant scholarship from the 신청가능 목록 (list of available scholarships), fill in the application form, click '신청' (Apply) → confirm '신청완료' (Application Completed).
※ Incoming graduate students (admitted applicants) due to register in the first term of 2027 cannot apply through mySNU. They must fill in the attached "장학선정신청서" (Scholarship Selection Application Form) and submit it by email to the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering scholarship officer (the academic advisor's name must be written on it).
1) Please write the reason for applying in detail. (An insufficient reason is grounds for non-selection.)
2) No academic advisor signature and no paper documents are required for the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering on-campus scholarship application. (The department office will separately request approval from each applicant's academic advisor. The advisor will review the reason for applying in detail, so write it without omissions.)
3) Entering a bank account number in your own name under mySNU → Personal Information (개인정보) is required.

4. Important notes
1) Students who do not apply for the scholarship are excluded from payment of (or recommendation for) on-campus and external scholarships. Additional applications are not accepted after the period.
2) To avoid any disadvantage in selection for on-campus and external scholarships based on the student financial aid income bracket (학자금지원구간), you must apply during the first National Scholarship application period → link: "Spring 2027 First National Scholarship Application" – Notices – Seoul National University Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering.
3) (Low-income) international student applicants: submit income proof documents as a PDF to the department office by email by Wednesday 6 January 2027.
4) If an income bracket calculation is needed for selection for scholarships that use the income bracket (Seonhan Injae Scholarship, Graduate Student Living Support Scholarship, other external foundation scholarships, etc.), you must apply for the National Scholarship. (The income bracket is valid only for the semester for which it was calculated; the previous semester's income bracket data cannot be used.)
- This includes those not eligible for the National Scholarship, such as returning students (from leave or military service) and recipients of other scholarships.
- Undergraduates: Korea Student Aid Foundation National Scholarship, national work-study, or student loan. ※ For an undergraduate recommendation letter for insufficient grades, the previous semester's grade average must be at least 1.7.
- Graduate students: the bracket can be calculated by applying for a student loan.
※ A new scholarship for low-income graduate students is planned from Spring 2027, so you must apply for an income bracket. (Income bracket calculation takes about 8 weeks, so apply in advance.)
5) Students on recommended leave of absence (권고휴학자) may be selected once, only for the semester in which they return, through a recommendation letter from the chair of their college's scholarship working committee; applications may be accepted outside the application period.

Inquiries: Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering scholarship officer (contact details are in the original notice).

Attached: one copy each of the scholarship application guides (undergraduate/graduate) and the application form.
Attachments (3):
1. 2027학년도 1학기 학부생 교내장학금 신청 안내.hwp (Spring 2027 undergraduate on-campus scholarship application guide)
2. 2027학년도 1학기 대학원생 교내장학금 신청 안내.hwp (Spring 2027 graduate on-campus scholarship application guide)
3-1. 2027학년도 1학기 장학선정신청서.hwp (Spring 2027 Scholarship Selection Application Form)
